bio: The atmosphere in this attractive historical corner-plot building is invitingly casual. Featuring high ceilings, warm wood panelling, cosy booths and large arched windows, the pretty dining space has the feel of a classic bistro. There is also a bar and, in summer, a terrace is set up out front, giving onto the street. The menu includes flavoursome dishes such as beef tartare, cod with Dijon mustard sauce and premium steaks. The smaller lunch menu features tempting options such as veal rissoles with carrots and mashed potatoes....
